name: glass-box-trading-video
description: SUB-04: the sub-five-minute submission video, rendered with Remotion from the frozen presentation-cutoff dataset. Its own package on purpose: the repository root package.json is S-ARM-01 digest material.

scripts.render: npm run typecheck && node scripts/check-dataset.mjs --frozen && remotion render src/index.ts GlassBoxTrading ../submission/glass-box-trading.mp4 --codec h264
scripts.render:dev: npm run typecheck && node scripts/check-dataset.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts GlassBoxTrading out/dev-preview.mp4 --codec h264
